pending_carry_forward.reason: N+1 query risk if the persona resolver is called per-route/per-resource within a single request; deferred to AUTH-03 to consider memoizing persona resolution across a single request scope — accepted per docs/research/AUTH-02.md Risk Register #9 (MEDIUM)

AUTH-01 D-05's `_parse_role` returns `""` when every role in the Keycloak token is a system role (`default-roles-*`, `offline_access`, `uma_authorization`). AUTH-02's resolver has no short-circuit for that input, so `""` falls through Tier-1, Tier-2 and Tier-3 and then raises `PersonaNotFoundError`. That outcome is CORRECT and fail-closed (AC-4 holds), so nothing ships broken -- this is a cost and observability gap, not a security one. Cost: the cache memoises only successful resolutions, so every request from such a principal re-pays a Tier-2 dict lookup and a Tier-3 Postgres query before failing. Observability: `PersonaNotFoundError("")` is indistinguishable in logs from `PersonaNotFoundError("some-real-role")`, but they are different operational problems -- the first points at Keycloak group configuration, the second at a missing persona mapping. Suggested fix if picked up: `if not role: raise PersonaNotFoundError(role, reason="empty_role")` ahead of Tier-1, plus one unit test. Not addressed in REQUIREMENTS.md, PLAN.md, DECISIONS.md or docs/test-cases/AUTH-02.json.
